metadata.description: RelAI — your project remembers everything. Documentation-first process framework for Claude Code.

plugins.name: relai
plugins.description: Your project remembers everything — documentation-first process framework for Claude Code

plugins.name: relai-panel
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI panel: a calm bar above the prompt with the active plan, stage and status, and a Tak/Nie row only while a decision card waits; /relai-panel opens a pane with Teraz (the stage and its next item), forms for the 14 RelAI commands, a map of plans and stages, the project documents and the session's measured costs in folded sections. Every change goes through a confirmation card. One network request only: the Anthropic pricing page, read after "Tak" on a card.

plugins.name: relai-progress
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI progress above the prompt: segments of the stage in progress or a /relai-crew run with the next item under them, a chip with the session's agents and their cost, and /relai-agents with the session's subagents priced from the project's price list. Reads files only: no model call, no network. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).

plugins.name: relai-cache-keeper
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). Four rings above the prompt: the prompt cache's time left, the 5-hour and weekly limits and the context, with the session's cost once; asks before a cold send of a big context and says when a fresh session pays off (/cache shows the reckoning). Calls the model only on the person's request (keep-warm pings, hand-off to a fresh chat).
